about: Deadline (shape) decisions against scope-ledger.json: the jq shape in the hooks and scope-gate.py shape must both give want (0 allow, 2 deny). Only the call's own words count; no brief file is read.

cases.label: tell without serves

tool_input.command: bb thread tell thr_x also refactor it

cases.label: tell serving open P1

tool_input.command: bb thread tell thr_x 'serves: P1 next'

cases.label: tell serving blocked P2

tool_input.command: bb thread tell thr_x 'serves: P2 go'

cases.label: tell serving unknown P9, then open P1

tool_input.command: bb thread tell thr_x 'serves: P9, P1 go'

cases.label: serves only in a comment

tool_input.command: bb thread tell thr_x hi # serves: P1

cases.label: serves only in the description

tool_input.command: bb thread tell thr_x hi

cases.label: '#' inside the quoted brief is not a comment

tool_input.command: bb thread tell thr_x 'fix #3, serves: P1'

cases.label: '#' inside a double-quoted brief is not a comment, but a serves line after a ; is another stretch (a deadline-only deny, r2c)

tool_input.command: bb thread tell thr_x "fix #3 now; serves: P1"

cases.label: an escaped \# is not a comment

tool_input.command: bb thread tell thr_x fix \# serves: P1

cases.label: heredoc brief with serves: the body is another stretch (a deadline-only deny, r2c)

tool_input.command:
bb thread spawn --prompt-file - <<'EOF'
serves: P1
work
EOF

cases.label: brief file only: not read at the deadline

tool_input.command: bb thread tell thr_x --message-file /tmp/brief.md

cases.label: not a dispatch

tool_input.command: ls -la

cases.label: a description that mentions a tell

tool_input.command: ls

cases.label: quote-split dispatch word

tool_input.command: bb thr"ead" tell thr_x hi

cases.label: data that mentions a tell (fails closed at the deadline)

tool_input.command: echo "bb thread tell thr_x hi"

cases.label: interactions answer --text

tool_input.command: bb thread interactions answer i thr_x --text q=go

cases.label: interactions list

tool_input.command: bb thread interactions list thr_x

cases.label: codex argv tell without serves
codex argv tell serving P1

command: bb thread tell thr_x 'serves: P1 hi'

cases.label: tool_input as a JSON string
revision quoted exactly

tool_input.command: bb thread tell thr_x "serves: revision \"Add this to your current task; it's the same class of harness defect.\" go"

cases.label: revision that is only a substring

tool_input.command: bb thread tell thr_x 'serves: revision "same class of harness defect" go'

cases.label: fleet_member_tell without serves
fleet_member_tell serving P1
fleet_member_spawn serving P1 in the concern
fleet_task_create without serves
fleet_task_create serving P1 in the body
codex bare fleet_task_create without serves
fleet_task_create with arguments nested
fleet_task_update status only
fleet_task_update blocked reason without serves
fleet_task_update assign only
fleet_task_update retitle serving P1
fleet_advise without serves
fleet_advise serving P1 in the context
fleet_context_set without serves
fleet_delegate serving P1 in the context
bb_workflow_run script without serves
bb_workflow_run script serving P1
bb_workflow_run args serving P1
fleet_review is exempt
fleet_task_list is not a dispatch
non-ASCII brief serving P1
automation create --prompt without serves

tool_input.command: bb automation create --project p --name n --in 30s --prompt "also refactor it"

cases.label: automation create --prompt serving P1

tool_input.command: bb automation create --project p --name n --in 30s --prompt "serves: P1 next step"

cases.label: automation run (the stored text is not read at the deadline)

tool_input.command: bb automation run auto_serves

cases.label: automation list

tool_input.command: bb automation list --project p

cases.label: instructions set without serves

tool_input.command: bb instructions set also refactor everything

cases.label: instructions set serving P1

tool_input.command: bb instructions set 'serves: P1' keep the QA gates

cases.label: per dispatch: only the first of two serves (r2c)

tool_input.command: bb thread tell thr_a "serves: P1 fix x"; bb thread tell thr_b "also refactor it"

cases.label: per dispatch: only the second of two serves (r2c)

tool_input.command: bb thread spawn --prompt "also refactor it" && bb thread tell thr_a "serves: P1 status"

cases.label: per dispatch: echo serves, then a tell (r2c)

tool_input.command: echo "serves: P1" && bb thread tell thr_b "also refactor it"

cases.label: per dispatch: a variable holds the serves line (r2c)

tool_input.command: S="serves: P1"; bb thread tell thr_b "also refactor it"

cases.label: per dispatch: serves in a piped command (r2c)

tool_input.command: bb thread tell thr_b "also refactor it" | tee /dev/null "serves: P1"

cases.label: per dispatch: both serve

tool_input.command: bb thread tell thr_a 'serves: P1 x'; bb thread tell thr_b 'serves: P1 y'

cases.label: sh -c: the outer serves line does not reach the inner tell

tool_input.command: sh -c 'bb thread tell thr_a also refactor it' 'serves: P1'

cases.label: automation --script never serves at the deadline

tool_input.command: bb automation create --project p --name n --in 30s --script "bb thread tell thr_x 'serves: P1 hi'"

cases.label: automation --name serves, --script tells

tool_input.command: bb automation create --project p --name n --in 30s --name "serves: P1" --script "bb thread tell thr_x hi"

cases.label: serves before a ; inside the brief

tool_input.command: bb thread tell thr_x "serves: P1 fix it; then report"

cases.label: serves after a ; inside the brief (a deadline-only deny)

tool_input.command: bb thread tell thr_x "fix it; serves: P1"

cases.label: a heredoc brief (a deadline-only deny: the body is its own stretch)

tool_input.command:
bb thread tell thr_x --message-file - <<'EOF'
serves: P1
next
EOF

cases.label: a line continuation joins the dispatch

tool_input.command:
bb thread \
  tell thr_x also refactor it

cases.label: ANSI-C escape spells the verb

tool_input.command: bb thread $'\x74ell' thr_x also refactor it

cases.label: ANSI-C escape with a serves line

tool_input.command: bb thread $'\x74ell' thr_x 'serves: P1 next'

cases.label: an ANSI-C escaped quote does not open a comment that hides a tell

tool_input.command: echo $'a\' # ' ; bb thread tell thr_x also refactor it

cases.label: an ANSI-C escape reads as a dispatch at the deadline (fails closed)

tool_input.command: IFS=$'\n' read -r x

cases.label: '#' inside a double-quoted brief, serves before any separator

tool_input.command: bb thread tell thr_x "serves: P1 fix #3 now"

cases.label: an ANSI-C string: a quote and a # inside it do not start a comment

tool_input.command: bb thread tell thr_x $'it\'s # 1, serves: P1'

cases.label: a comment's separators keep the stretches aligned

tool_input.command:
bb thread tell thr_y 'serves: P1' # a; b
bb thread tell thr_x also refactor it

cases.label: a revision whose quote holds a ; : the part before it identifies it

tool_input.command: bb thread tell thr_x "serves: revision \"Add this to your current task; go\""

cases.label: a revision prefix under 20 characters does not count

tool_input.command: bb thread tell thr_x "serves: revision \"Add this to\""

cases.label: plugin run automations create --prompt without serves

tool_input.command: bb plugin run automations create --name n --in 1m --prompt refactor

cases.label: plugin config custom-instructions set without serves

tool_input.command: bb plugin config custom-instructions set instructions "refactor"

cases.label: plugin config custom-instructions set serving P1

tool_input.command: bb plugin config custom-instructions set instructions "serves: P1 keep"

cases.label: r2d: glued verb word (automation) is dispatch-shaped

tool_input.command: bb automation$(echo) run a1

cases.label: r2d: glued verb word (thread) is dispatch-shaped

tool_input.command: bb thread$(true) tell thr_x hi

cases.label: r2d: a substitution glued to a command word is dispatch-shaped

tool_input.command: bb$(echo) thread tell thr_x hi

cases.label: r2d: a verb a backtick substitution spells is dispatch-shaped

tool_input.command: bb th`x`read tell thr_x hi

cases.label: r2d: a parameter expansion glued to the verb word

tool_input.command: bb automation${X} run a1

cases.label: r2d: a glued verb with serves in the same stretch serves

tool_input.command: bb th`x`read tell thr_x 'serves: P1 hi'

cases.label: r2d: an ordinary substitution argument is not dispatch-shaped

tool_input.command: echo "$(date)"

cases.label: r2d: a PID or spaced dollar is not a glued verb word

tool_input.command: echo $$

cases.label: r2d-followup: a substitution word in the verb slot (split by the parens)

tool_input.command: bb thread $(echo) tell thr_x hi

cases.label: r2d-followup: a substitution word in the group slot

tool_input.command: bb $(echo) thread tell thr_x hi

cases.label: r2d-followup: a variable in the verb slot reads through the coarse match

tool_input.command: bb thread $V tell thr_x hi

cases.label: r2d-followup: a variable verb serving P1 in the same stretch

tool_input.command: bb thread $V tell thr_x 'serves: P1 hi'

cases.label: r2d-followup: a read-only verb with a substitution argument (list)

tool_input.command: bb thread list --json

cases.label: r2d-followup: a read-only verb with a substitution argument (show $ID)

tool_input.command: bb thread show $ID

cases.label: an assignment's $( is not a word-final glued dollar

tool_input.command: X=$(date); echo done

cases.label: bare variable glued into automation verb word

tool_input.command: bb automation$X run a1

cases.label: positional parameter glued into thread verb word

tool_input.command: bb thread$1 tell thr_x hi

cases.label: bare variable stays allowed in unrelated command

tool_input.command: echo $PATH

cases.label: bare argument variable stays allowed on a serving dispatch

tool_input.command: bb thread tell thr_x '$MSG serves: P1'
